steps.content: Not far away, heatwaves carrying coarse sand hit in waves.
FAC's anti-Mania soldiers line up in a formation, their weapons emitting a faint blue light, resisting the flames that are exceptionally dazzling even in broad daylight.

steps.speaker: FAC Soldier
steps.content: Press the attack! It's the Apostle of Ashes! This Tide of Ashes is indeed her doing!

steps.speaker: FAC Soldier
steps.content: Set up the maximum power anti-Mania weapon! Quick!
Yao, surrounded at the center, is covered in flames, her eyes once clear, now swallowed by the flames, making it impossible for you to see clearly.
With a wave of her hand, her feathers block the bullets, causing explosion and smoke in the air.
In the midst of WhiteSands, she is almost indistinguishable from the Apostles that follow the Tide of Ashes.
Yao, surrounded at the center, is covered in flames, her eyes once clear, now swallowed by the flames, making it impossible for you to see clearly.
With a wave of her hand, her feathers block the bullets, causing explosion and smoke in the air.
In the midst of WhiteSands, she is almost indistinguishable from the Apostles that follow the Tide of Ashes.
Yao, surrounded at the center, is covered in flames, her eyes once clear, now swallowed by the flames, making it impossible for you to see clearly.
With a wave of her hand, her feathers block the bullets, causing explosion and smoke in the air.
In the midst of WhiteSands, she is almost indistinguishable from the Apostles that follow the Tide of Ashes.
A FAC soldier beside you sets up their weapon, pulling the trigger, but you step forward, stopping their action before they can complete it.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: That's not the look of the Apostle of Ashes, things haven't escalated to that level yet.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Attacking blindly might backfire, let me try first.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: She is a Sinner, the shackles are still responsive, I can hold her off first, you guys act based on the situation.

At this moment, Yao is indeed different from when she was at the Bureau, attacks seem to have no effect on her, seeing the situation turning into a stalemate, the frontline personnel had no choice but to agree with your plan.
This area is permeated with an abnormal Mania, amidst the vast Tide of Ashes, in a hostile environment, Yao has completely entered another state.

Her wings blaze with fire, her golden eyes sharp, the non-human fangs and claws all revealed, confronting the numerous anti-Mania weapons in the contamination storm without being overpowered, yet appearing desolate.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: It's me, Yao.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Let me help you, okay? I've made them stop.
You slowly approach her, extending your hand towards her against the scorching winds.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: Don't be afraid, come, give me your hand.

choices.text: Don't be afraid, come, give me your hand.

steps.content: You want to step forward, but you can't. Scorching debris hitting the mask, the protective suit starting to dissolve, your body instinctively pulls you back, and even your consciousness starts to fade.
And Yao just watches you, not attacking, nor coming closer.
She no longer looks so panicked, standing tall in the center of the heat, full of power, like a siren in the flames, and a stranger far away from you.

steps.speaker: Yao
steps.content: I didn't want you to come, but I knew you would...

steps.speaker: Yao
steps.content: So, I also have something to tell you...

steps.speaker: Yao
steps.content: ...You don't need to look for me, not anymore. Stay away from danger... I am... the danger...
You are stunned. You've never heard her speak to you in this tone before, even though not long ago, she was the little one sticking close to you.
She has grown again, growing overnight into someone you don't recognize.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: It's a misunderstanding. They're not afraid of you, but something else. They're afraid you'll become something else.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: But I know you won't, I know what kind of person Yao is, I know what kind of person you want to become. Even if there's trouble, I'll work with you to get it over.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Come back, Yao. You are not, and you never will be my enemy, as long as you don't want to.
Yao slowly lowers her head, silently looking at her feet.

steps.speaker: Yao
steps.content: No... it's not their fault... not any of you...

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: It's me, who can't become what you all expected...

steps.speaker: Yao
steps.content: I often dream, dream of here, dream of farther places... dream of the seer everyone is expecting.

steps.speaker: Yao
steps.content: She wields a sword and stands against monsters, in front of the storms, the disasters, protecting everyone. She's always smiling, walking among the crowd, trusted and beloved by all—she always belongs to the human world.

steps.speaker: Yao
steps.content: I know, that's the "Yao" everyone hopes to see. So you kept me, through my eyes, searching for that beautiful human.
Her voice is slow, but fluently expresses herself to you.
But now her voice is tinged with the echo of Mania, constantly reverberating in your mind.

steps.speaker: Yao
steps.content: But I'm no longer human.

steps.speaker: Yao
steps.content: Even if I dreamed it, remembered it, the things about that person are so far from me. Everything just becomes chaotic and impure.

steps.speaker: Yao
steps.content: Even by your side, I can't feel at ease. I only see my monstrous body, see how different I am from everyone else. I can't go back to the past, I can't meet your expectations.

steps.speaker: Yao
steps.content: But in the dreams, I see a wider world, broader time, greater life... There's no need to imprison my strength, no need to suppress myself...

steps.speaker: Yao
steps.content: I can't be caged. I have my own calling. I want to <color=#fb9259>burn bright</color>...

steps.speaker: Yao
steps.content: I know... I long to return to the disaster... long to face the Apostles... long for my true self...
Yao says no more, the wings formed of flames slowly spread behind her, without any grand gestures, the slowly rising heat is enough to drive you all back.
You understand Yao's intention, she is driving all of you away.

steps.speaker: Yao
steps.content: Go. I don't want to hurt you, nor can I return to you.

steps.speaker: Yao
steps.content: All this is just what was. And there's going to be something after.

steps.speaker: Yao
steps.content: The seer named Xu is dead. The current me can't escape Mania and disaster—I'm destined for them.

steps.speaker: Yao
steps.content: ...Let me go... I'm sorry...
She speaks calmly and decisively, with convincing power. But she is also your Sinner, subtle emotions from the other end of the shackles pierce through this nearly perfect lie.
You understand her pain. You feel her sadness.
Ignoring the persuasion of those around you, you step forward on the scorching white sand.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: I should be the one saying sorry.

choices.text: I should be the one saying sorry.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I'm sorry, trapping you in the Bureau wasn't my intention, I didn't know it would be so painful for you there.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: It was presumptuous of me, I naively assumed from my perspective that you belonged there.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: But I never needed you to become the "seer," from the moment I took you back, it was never necessary.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Moreover, I remember the message Yanyan sent me when she found you.

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: Chief, Chief! Big news! Tremendous news!!

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: We found Yao! It's really her!!

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: You gotta trust me! She's exactly like Yao, even they confirmed it. And her energy system is the same as Yao's!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: What we're looking for isn't the "seer," but... <color=#fb9259>Yao</color>.
The movement of those wings gradually stops, and strands of pure white smoke slowly disperse.
You reach out your hand, again slowly, slowly walking towards Yao.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I'm glad you were born into this world, glad you came to my side. No matter what form you take, where you choose to go, I hope you can find happiness.

options: I hope you can be happy.

choices.text: I hope you can be happy.

steps.speaker: Yao
steps.content: But I... I'm not human. I can't stay by your side.

options: Yet you will never be our enemy.

choices.text: Yet you will never be our enemy.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Look, you can now precisely control the flames, not even a spark escapes, nor does it harm anyone.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: So don't scare me anymore, let's talk some more, okay? Tell me what you really think, where you want to go.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Even if you have to go... just like that, without any explanation.
Yao stares at you blankly, her beautiful eyes once again revealing that unique clarity.

steps.speaker: Yao
steps.content: ...The one who can't bear to leave... is me...
Yao, who had been gazing at you, suddenly stops dead in her tracks, her hand that was about to reach out to you no longer moving towards you.
She frowns, looking around as if sensing something...
But in an instant, the flames that Yao had gradually calmed suddenly reignite!
Her eyes flash a wild, dangerous signal, and she fiercely pounces in your direction!

steps.speaker: Yao
steps.content: Leave! Go!!!
At the same time, the alarm of the Tide of Ashes goes off, tearing through the calm and agitating everyone's nerves.

steps.speaker: FAC Soldier
steps.content: Protect the Chief!! Increase the firepower!!

steps.speaker: FAC Soldier
steps.content: Stop the rampaging Sinner from getting close!
The armed personnel you asked to put down their weapons see Yao rushing towards you, immediately raise their guns, and shoot at Yao.
Yao, disregarding the bullets hitting her, sees only you. She spreads her golden wings, flying towards you like a light breaking through the sky.
But in an instant, the flames that Yao had gradually calmed suddenly reignite!
Her eyes flash a wild, dangerous signal, and she fiercely pounces in your direction!

Yao, disregarding the bullets hitting her, sees only you. She spreads her golden wings, flying towards you like a light breaking through the sky.
Suddenly, the ground beneath you shakes violently! An Apostle you've never detected before attacks you from beneath the WhiteSands!
The black figure distorts your consciousness, flinging you harshly to the ground from mid-air!

steps.speaker: FAC Soldier
steps.content: Where did this come from?!

steps.speaker: FAC Soldier
steps.content: No... Quick!! Prioritize protecting the Chief!!!
The sudden appearance of the Apostle of Ashes catches everyone off guard, they almost seem to harbor the thought of swallowing you in their attack.
The pain of impact and fracture nearly makes you lose consciousness, the despair brought by the Apostle of Ashes tightly entwines you, making it nearly impossible to breathe.

steps.speaker: FAC Soldier
steps.content: Damn it!!! Our attacks can't stop them!!

steps.speaker: FAC Soldier
steps.content: Call for backup immediately!! Immediately!!!!
Death-like blackness envelops you, but through those flowing gaps, you glimpse a flame as dazzling as the sun.

steps.speaker: Yao
steps.content: Let him go... Don't you... hurt them!!
steps.female_content: Let her go... Don't you... hurt them!!

steps.content: You feel the shackles trembling.
The golden figure crosses the boundary of death and stands in front of you, dispersing the painful aura.
Flames blaze furiously, burning away the black contamination that sought to swallow her. Accompanied by blood-curdling screams, Yao attacks the giant Apostle recklessly.
Ignoring the damage, regardless of the consequences.

steps.speaker: Shattering Sound
steps.content: Clack!

steps.content: Let him go... Don't you... hurt them!!

steps.speaker: Yao
steps.content: <size=44>Stay away!! Stay away from them!!</size>

steps.speaker: Yao
steps.content: Your opponent is me!

steps.speaker: Yao
steps.content: Solarfire!!
Yao, like a wild beast, tears through the Apostle of Ashes, driving them away from you.
And the flames on her body, with her burst of power, form a red firewall in front of you, blocking all harm.
It's an unparalleled scene, the first time everyone directly felt such natural and savage power.
Your eardrums vibrate, your consciousness evaporates with the flame, leaving only awe in the depths of your heart.
Yeah..., you thought to yourself.
You know very well, if Yao wanted to hurt you, there were plenty of opportunities in the Bureau, she didn't need to wait until she was trapped in the WhiteSands.
She never intended to harm any of you. She was simply following her instincts—not the instincts of belonging to a monster, but the kindest instincts to protect humans and eliminate calamities.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Attack! Now!! Attack the Apostle!!!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: They are the source of the alarm!! Quick!!!
The giant bodies of the Apostles of Ashes gradually fall under the relentless attack of everyone, but the unsettling buzzing sound still stubbornly persists.
You know, they are gathering all their strength, preparing to launch their final attack.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Watch out!!!
As the power full of contamination targets Yao, you instinctively run towards her. The shackles on your hand glow faintly, wanting to give Yao more strength.
But the moment you step into the attack range, the Apostles of Ashes, as if sensing something, ferociously shifts their attack towards you!
The giant golden wings once again appear, burning all unease to ashes.
The flaming greatsword has been thrown aside, Yao blocks all attacks for you, her hands propped by your side, trying not to touch you, to keep a distance.
Yet even at this distance, you still feel the scorching heat, Yao in battle is as hot as the sun.

steps.speaker: Yao
steps.content: The things you said... how could I ever leave? But you know we can't go back...

steps.speaker: Yao
steps.content: Look, this body of mine... it can't even touch you anymore...
Her arms, dark with a red glow, the sand in her palm sizzles, even the tears that drip on your face feel scorching.
This time, you see her eyes clearly.

The flaming greatsword has been thrown aside, Yao blocks all attacks for you, her hands propped by your side, trying not to touch you, to keep a distance.
Yet even at this distance, you still feel the scorching heat, Yao in battle is as hot as the sun.

steps.speaker: Yao
steps.content: The things you said... how could I ever leave? But you know we can't go back...

steps.speaker: Yao
steps.content: Look, this body of mine... it can't even touch you anymore...
Her arms, dark with a red glow, the sand in her palm sizzles, even the tears that drip on your face feel scorching.
This time, you see her eyes clearly.
You know who she is. In both past and present lives, she possesses the sharpest sense of disaster and bravely charges into calamities alone, facing powerful enemies on her own.
Regardless of memory loss or physical distortion, even with the contamination of the Sun Crow Apostle mixed in her body, she never abandons her love for humanity.
Whether in life or death, as Yao or as Xu... You might not understand "souls," but you understand her in front of you, and that has never changed from the beginning to the end.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Yao, the sunlight... represents hope.
You raise your hand through the scorching flames, the crimson shackles linking two entirely different bodies.
But this time, it's not a prohibitive command, but a warm, embracing force.
